levels.זיהוי קידוח: chart-index, chart-change, chart-yearly, chart-season, chart-oil, table-wells, table-oil, kpi:wells, kpi:wells_last, kpi:cmp_median, insight:cmp, insight:coverage — per-well grouping key; shown in the top-wells tables
levels.שם: table-wells, table-oil — latest-dated name per well
levels.תאריך: chart-yearly, chart-index, chart-change, chart-season, chart-inst, chart-pause, chart-oil, kpi:span, insight:wettest, insight:season — two formats (YYYY-MM-DD / DD/MM/YYYY) parsed per row
levels.מפלס (מטרים): chart-index, chart-change, chart-season, table-wells, kpi:cmp_median, kpi:rising_share, kpi:last_yoy, insight:cmp, insight:wettest, insight:driest, insight:index, insight:season, insight:depth — below-sea-level count
levels.משך הפסקה בשעות: chart-pause, insight:pause — codes grouped into 6 ordered bands, unknown codes fall into the unknown band
levels.שם מוסד מודד: chart-inst, insight:inst — spellings differing only by quote marks are merged
levels.הערה: chart-notes — empty and the no-remarks value are treated as no note
levels._resource_name: skip: synthetic file name; dates are parsed by format, not by file
